title: An agent confirms its own preview with no person involved
what: The one-time code is returned to whoever asked for the preview, so an agent can preview and confirm in two calls without showing anything to a person. Documented in docs/replacing-memories.md as a limit (the command line is the strong gate). The check says an agent-only confirmation should not retire a note; honest result: it does.

expect.desc: an agent's own confirmation is refused until a person confirms
